scope.maintainedRepositoryRule: All pull requests updated on or after 2026-08-01 UTC, plus every current open pull request.
scope.upstreamRule: All authored pull requests updated on or after 2026-08-01 UTC, every authored current open pull request regardless of age, and older closed predecessors ChartSearchAI #26 and frontend #12.
scope.excluded: Other authors' upstream pull requests; older closed maintained-repository history outside the date window; unpublished local changes; per-file defect validation.

methodology.metadata: The comprehensive GitHub collection was captured on 2026-09-06. Catalyst delivery records #79, #100, #101, #105, #108, and #109 were refreshed from live GitHub on 2026-09-10 UTC; other mergeability and check details retain the earlier snapshot date.
methodology.effortGrouping: Editorial grouping from titles, PR descriptions and current project roadmap; not a GitHub project field.
methodology.ci: Detailed check results were read for every authored upstream PR open in the comprehensive snapshot and for the current Catalyst delivery merges. Historical merged PRs generally have checks:null. Missing checks are not passing checks.
methodology.reviews: Submitted reviews read for all 12 open upstream PRs. Review-thread counts inspected only for current integration PRs; unresolved markers are not validated defects.
methodology.mergeability: Raw REST mergeability fields are used; the normalized connector PR tool previously misreported QueryStore #68 as false. GitHub raw PR base.sha may reflect the merge-base snapshot; current upstream-main drift was separately measured for the integration PRs.

currentIntegrationValidation.scope: Checks the exact merged integration pins, QueryStore Maven clean install, ChartSearchAI Maven clean package against that source artifact, and frontend translation extraction, lint, TypeScript, unit tests and production build.
currentIntegrationValidation.limitation: No claim of live dual-source browser acceptance; that remains part of the Feature 008 local owner gate.
